pyramiding_rule: Absolute ban on opening multiple trades within 300 seconds of an active order on the same symbol; minimum distance between add-ons locked to +1.5x ATR.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Reject all market entries if 1-minute ATR exceeds $2.50 or if spread widens beyond 30 pips on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Lock 50% volume at +$5.00 profit per 0.01 lot, trailing remainder with a 15-pip dynamic step up to target +$15.00-$30.00.
